disposition: ACCEPT exact product/test/guide source and fourteen frozen compatibility controls

changed_regions: TAG_RE declaration replaced by TAG_START_RE declaration
scope_proof.unchanged: All imports, WS_RE, helper code, CanvasAPI methods and caller wiring byte-exact

source_findings: Tag candidates require an ASCII letter, slash followed by ASCII letter, exclamation mark or question mark after '<'; numeric math and spaced '<' remain literal.
Complete comments consume through '-->' rather than their first greater-than sign. Incomplete comments retain their suffix.
Within a tag candidate, matching quote characters alone end quoted data; quoted greater-than/apparent-tag characters cannot close the outer tag.
Every scanning continuation advances position; a nested unquoted '<' preserves the unsupported prefix and resumes forward. EOF preserves the incomplete token exactly once.
Real tag/comment/declaration removal emits a separator, then one unchanged global html.unescape and whitespace collapse preserve the public text-projection behavior.
No input/case identifiers or frozen expected strings appear in production logic; no additional dependency, authentication, network or API request path is introduced.

execution.environment: Local orchestration Python 3.12.14, not estate-native or installed consumer execution
execution.isolation: One baseline and one candidate invocation, stdin-free fixed command arguments; Python -I -B; exact AST extraction of the production helper plus its two regex declarations; only re/html stdlib bindings injected. The frozen receiving function and all expected values remain exact.
execution.consumer_gate: Root separately owns actual assignment_brief and full API fixture receiving; this review does not claim those as its own

limits: Helper output is not browser-visible text, HTML sanitization or executable-content suppression.
Fourteen listed controls do not imply arbitrary malformed HTML reconstruction or complete HTML grammar support.
No native host, Canvas service, user data, install, Actions, or new product-source write was involved.

maintained_tests.scope: Actual helper comparisons plus CanvasAPI.assignment_brief with explicitly authored response transport; assertions retain request, prompt, metadata and input custody. Author/root execute this separate gate; no rerun claimed here.

guide.assessment: Truthfully limits token grammar, one-pass decoding, incomplete suffix treatment, script/style behavior, output escaping and nonclaims. No hidden-content suppression, full malformed HTML parsing or live/installed qualification is promised.
